title: Home Comfort Financing Returned-Payment Fee: Step Schedule by Earlier Returns
content:
**Schedule of charges, footnote to the returned-payment fee — Home Comfort Financing.**

The scheduled returned-payment fee steps down with the number of other payments returned within the returned-payment lookback, the payment this fee concerns not counted: when none it is $15.00, when exactly one it is $20.00, and when two or more it is the plan's returned-payment fee. The returned-payment lookback covers payments returned less than 24 whole months before the date of handling.

| Other payments returned in the last 24 whole months (the payment this fee concerns excluded) | Scheduled returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| none | $15.00 |
| exactly one | $20.00 |
| two or more | the plan's returned-payment fee |

Returns are counted by their returned-payment entries on the account, dated less than 24 whole months before the date of handling.

## Counting cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Returned-payment entries in the last 24 whole months, this one included | Other returns | Scheduled fee |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | $15.00 |
| 2 | 1 | $20.00 |
| 3 | 2 | the plan's returned-payment fee |

A payment returned 25 whole months before the date of handling falls outside the lookback and is not counted.
